headline: Dangote Refinery Cuts Wholesale Petrol Price to About $0.90 a Litre
summary: Nigeria's Dangote Refinery trimmed its wholesale petrol price by about $0.04 a litre to approximately $0.90 a litre ahead of the January 2027 vote.
why: Pricing adjustments by major regional petroleum refiners impact domestic fuel costs, inflation, and profit margins across downstream energy sectors.

impacts.name: Oil & Gas Refining
impacts.why: Lower wholesale fuel prices reduce input costs for transport and downstream distributors.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
